title: Read a bounded hosted response
responsibility: Reads response bytes while enforcing a maximum size even when Content-Length is missing.

inputs.name: hostedResponse.response
inputs.description: The HTTP response whose body is read. A Content-Length consisting of decimal digits and greater than the limit causes rejection before the body is read.

inputs.name: hostedResponse.limit
inputs.description: The maximum accepted byte count. Reading rejects when the accumulated size first exceeds it, while exactly the limit is allowed; 11534336 is rendered as 11 MiB in an oversize message and other values as 16 MiB.

outputs.name: hostedResponse
outputs.description: A promise that resolves to the response body bytes in order as a Uint8Array, or an empty Uint8Array when no reader is available. Reading rejects as soon as the accumulated size exceeds the limit.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Explicitly throws Error when a decimal Content-Length exceeds the limit or the streamed byte count crosses it. Read failures from the response stream are also propagated as rejections.
